Chapter 6712: Farewell, Master

Chapter 6712: Farewell, Master

Overlords and other masters stood in a daze, aware of the ultimate battle just now between the highest level of immortals, nearly reaching the high heaven level.

Alas, they couldn’t see anything since it took place before the primordial. The strongest overlords couldn’t trace back far enough on the river of time. Nevertheless, they sensed apocalyptic shockwaves and trembled in fear.

“It’s over.” Li Qiye returned and let out a sigh.

“Yes!” Supreme Black Ancestor’s group cheered loudly. Li Qiye’s return was all that needed to be said.

Everyone was shocked by the result. They saw how Taichu, Fiendish Ground, and Evil Transformation fused into the celestial body. It seemed unbeatable with the help of the primordial tree.

Its defeat shattered all logic - the unkillable was killed. The immortals couldn’t imagine what Li Qiye had done.

“Farewell, Master.” Weizhen kneeled toward the outline of the primordial tree; tears streamed down his cheeks. He understood the particles and halos were his master, hence his display of respect.

Moshi, Dingtian, Poye, and Taichu - they reigned over this world and educated many geniuses. Today marked his true death.

However, few truly mourned his death. Weizhen was one of them. He kowtowed repeatedly for this was the only thing he could do.

Nevertheless, his master desired this outcome - dying during the dao search. He even had the taste of becoming the high heaven moments before death and experienced immortality.

“I’m happy for you, Master.” Weizhen said.

Meanwhile, at a different part in space, certain immortals continued their battle - Desolate Ancestor versus Bao Pu and Primal Yin Immortal Ghost.

Although the duo had the help of the redemption grounds, they were still at a disadvantage. They had tried to flee to no avail.

Furthermore, they just saw Li Qiye coming back. This meant he had won the throne over their world. This cultivator had slain the high heaven body, meaning he could crush them like ants.

They wanted to hide in a hole forever, but Desolate Ancestor’s saber just wouldn’t let them go, severing their escape path repeatedly.

They didn’t hold back and tried everything since time was not on their side. Unfortunately, their ace cards couldn’t reverse the tides.

She and Calamitious Edge only grew stronger with time. They realized she had grown far stronger compared to before.

“Damn!” Their combined domains shattered to one slash, prompting them to curse.

“Abyss Devour!” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost burned his true blood, fusing entirely with the redemption ground.

The battlefield turned dark as the abyss surrounded Desolate Ancestor, wanting to drag her to the bottom.

“Clank!” The gleam of her saber still illuminated everything before she slashed the abyss in half.

“Help me!” The ghost shouted, wanting Bao Pu’s help in mending the abyss.

However, his ally attempted to smash the blockade instead. He knew this was hopeless after their domains went down. Therefore, he took advantage of the ghost’s desperate move and wanted to run.

“You-” The ghost was furious, abandoned when he needed his ally the most.

“Pluff!” Calamitious Edge didn’t let him finish the sentence.

Since he turned his true blood, his body and true fate were left defenseless. His withered shell couldn’t stop her slash. Of course, even his prime state couldn’t take a direct hit.

Therefore, she dismembered him and his true fate. During his last moment, his eyes opened wide, not with terror but with seething rage. Had Bao Pu not run, he might have survived the slash.
